reason: C2 is chosen because it proposes a concrete intervention (high-pressure and high-temperature treatment) and gives a specific mechanism (HPHT-induced formation of a hierarchically patterned microstructure with coherent interfaces) that is physically consistent and unique to the high-entropy alloy system. It also makes quantified predictions (doubling of strength to 1150 MPa and tensile ductility to 36% after HPHT treatment) and has a decisive falsification test (comparison of mechanical properties of HEAs with and without HPHT treatment).
